findings.title: List id was used as a file name without a check
findings.detail: An id such as ../escape or a/b would write a wav and png outside <out>/generated. Two entries with one id wrote the same file twice; the second overwrote the first and the manifest listed the id twice. Now an id must match [A-Za-z0-9_-]+ and a second entry with the same id is refused with a message. Two new tests in tools/audio/tests/test_generated_build.py failed before the fix and pass after.

findings.title: A refused or failed generated entry does not fail the build
findings.detail: A sha256 mismatch, a missing raw file and the catch-all except Exception only print a line. The manifest still validates and the exit code is 0, so a changed raw file makes a sound vanish from the library with no failing status. The builder chose this and said so. I did not change it: it needs the owner's decision, because a hard failure stops the whole build for one bad file.

findings.title: Start sample differs by one from the page copy for two sounds
findings.detail: thruster_pulse_a and gear_deploy start one sample (0.02 ms) later than the file the owner heard. The record keeps the cut in seconds with four decimals, which cannot name the start sample. Not changed.

findings.title: Rules no test catches
findings.detail: See point 2 (a) to (h). Not added: none is a proven defect.

findings.title: Stale removal deletes the old copy of an entry refused in this run
findings.detail: If a raw file changes so its sha256 fails, the old processed copy is removed and the sound is gone from the manifest. Consistent with never building from another file, but see the second finding.
